name: x-mcp-ai
description: Safety-first MCP server exposing the X (Twitter) API v2 as typed, policy-gated tools, with a two-axis policy model and 2026 pay-per-use cost controls.
author: Ivan Baev <ivanbbaev@gmail.com>

scripts.test:coverage: node scripts/coverage-guard.mjs preflight && npm run build && c8 --check-coverage --lines 90 --branches 80 --functions 95 --reporter=text --reporter=json-summary node --test "build/test/**/*.test.js" && node scripts/coverage-guard.mjs floors
scripts.gates: npm run build && node scripts/docs-gen.mjs --check && node scripts/context-gate.mjs --quiet && node scripts/server-json-guard.mjs
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run lint && npm run format:check && node --test "build/test/**/*.test.js"
scripts.check: npm run verify && npm run test:coverage && npm run gates && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high

trademark: x-mcp-ai is an independent, unofficial project and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by X Corp. "X", "Twitter", and related marks are trademarks of X Corp, used nominatively only to describe interoperability with the X API.
